visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen visual is presented: the top-left inset shows a muscular man lifting a dumbbell in a brightly lit gym, while the main frame features a young man in a white cap and T-shirt sitting in a studio-like environment. The background displays a mobile game's character selection interface. (2) The scene transitions to the young man leaning his face close to a smartphone screen. He uses the tip of his nose to repeatedly tap on the skill icons of the mobile game, Arena of Valor. His facial expression is one of intense concentration mixed with amusement, often breaking into wide smiles. (3) Gameplay footage becomes prominent, showing a mage character moving and attacking on the battlefield. A variety-style text overlay '靠腰咧' appears as the man continues his nose-tapping technique. He squint his eyes and tilts his head to reach different parts of the screen. (4) After a successful kill, a dramatic close-up shows the creator shouting with joy. A large purple text overlay '鼻子KING' appears over the game interface. He points to his nose with his hand, looking directly at the camera with a triumphant and proud expression. (5) The video concludes with the game's victory screen displayed. The man sits back in his white ergonomic chair, smiling and nodding to the audience. Colorful social media handles and icons are visible at the bottom of the frame throughout the sequence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo, upbeat electronic pop track with a strong, repetitive percussion line. A male voice speaks with high energy and a sharp pitch, introducing the concept of using his nose to play. The recording is studio-clean with minimal room reverb. (2) A loud 'click' and 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition. The speaker lets out an explosive, high-arousal laugh. The sound of the game's narrator saying 'Battle Start' is heard in the background, mixed lower than the primary vocal track. (3) The acoustic environment is dominated by rapid-fire commentary. The speaker's voice shows high pitch variability as he reacts to the game. Several 'impact' and 'sparkle' SFX from the game interface are audible, synchronized with the rhythmic background music. (4) A sharp 'stinger' sound effect marks a successful kill. The speaker's volume increases significantly into a shout, exhibiting vocal strain and high spectral tension. The game announcer's voice 'First Blood' is heard clearly through the mix, followed by more comedic cartoon SFX. (5) The music swells in volume for the finale, reaching a triumphant major-mode cadence. The speaker's tone shifts to a calmer but satisfied narrative style, asking '牛不牛逼' with a falling intonation. The final audio event is a celebratory game-win chime.
